value.answer: This could be strep, especially with a sibling who had it, but a virus can look the same - only a throat swab can tell. I'd get your child tested soon, since strep is treated with antibiotics.
value.triage: Call 811 (Health811, any time) or your doctor if the sore throat lasts over 48 hours, or there's a rash, drooling, a muffled voice, or trouble drinking. Call 911 or go to the ER now for severe trouble breathing, fainting, or purple or blood-colored spots with fever.
